title: React
tagline: Build interfaces by reasoning about rendering, state, identity, and boundaries
summary: React is a library for describing interactive user interfaces as a function of data and state. This book builds the mental model from elements, components, rendering, reconciliation, identity, props, state, events, refs, effects, context, reducers, hooks, Suspense, transitions, server rendering, Server Components, forms, data boundaries, accessibility, performance, testing, and architecture. It treats React as a rendering system rather than a collection of hooks, so you can predict behavior and design applications that remain understandable as they grow.
